chunks: As for Masjid al-Khayf in Minā, Jābir narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
Seven hundred Prophets prayed in Masjid al-Khayf.

key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Minā, the well-known site connected to hajj rites
key_terms.جَابِرٌ: Jābir, the transmitter of this report
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْخَيْفِ: Masjid al-Khayf, a blessed mosque in Minā

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of Masjid al-Khayf in Minā according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام the great merit of Masjid al-Khayf in Minā. Its significance is highlighted by the statement that seven hundred Prophets performed salat there, indicating its sanctity and honored place.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.688 - As for the Mosque of Al-Khayf in Mina, it has been narrated by Jabir from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"Seven hundred prophets prayed in the Mosque of al-Khayf."
